title: Sihon falls by the sword of the Word
english: [[Sihon >> Bible:Numbers 21:21-24]], proud and a barren tree, falls in battle with Israel — by the sword, that is [[the sword of the Spirit, the word of God >> Bible:Ephesians 6:17]]. The spiritual Sihon, the devil, is laid low by that sword.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XII; title soft as XII in OCR; Sihon/Balaam start CLOSEOUT.

title: Israel’s dominion in his land
english: [[Israel dominated all his land >> Bible:Numbers 21:24-25]]. Every earthly region may be called Sihon’s land; Christ and the church dominate it when they conquer sins.

title: Balak sends for Balaam
english: [[Balak sends for Balaam to curse Israel >> Bible:Numbers 22:5-6]]. So begins Balaam’s story — a mixed prophecy, now blameworthy, now praiseworthy.
